app.name: PnP Cards
app.tagline: Print and play cards, ready to print

cards.clearConfirm: Remove all cards from the list?
cards.empty: Drop your card images here or press “Add images”.
cards.emptyHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or TIFF. A name ending in “ x3” adds 3 copies.
cards.dropHere: Drop the images to add them
cards.noDpi: Some images don’t state their resolution and will be treated as 72 dpi. Force the card width or height under Card size so they print at the right size.
cards.errorEmpty: There are no cards to print: they all have zero copies.
cards.errorBlank: Blank images take their size from another card. Add an image or force the width and height under Card size.
cards.errorUnknown: The PDF could not be created ({{message}}). Try fewer images or check that none are damaged.
cards.ignoredWithProject_one: The project was opened; the other dropped image wasn’t added.
cards.ignoredWithProject_other: The project was opened; the other {{count}} dropped images weren’t added.
cards.missingWarning_one: {{count}} image can’t be found and won’t be printed. Find it or remove it.
cards.missingWarning_other: {{count}} images can’t be found and won’t be printed. Find them or remove them.
cards.errorTemplate: Choose a template with at least one slot under Layout.

settings.duplexHint: Reverses the order on even pages.
settings.sizeHint: If you don’t force a size, each image’s resolution is used.
settings.noTemplates: You don’t have any templates yet.
settings.templateMarks: With a template, each slot gets crop marks at its corners.

preview.empty: Add cards to see how each page will look.
preview.label: Preview of page {{page}}
preview.clamped_one: The crop doesn’t fit {{count}} card; it will be fitted to its edge.
preview.clamped_other: The crop doesn’t fit {{count}} cards; it will be fitted to each card’s edge.

crop.title: Crop
crop.zeroHint: 0 mm uses the whole image in that direction.
crop.clamped: The crop doesn’t fit this image and is fitted to its edge.
crop.hint: Drag the rectangle or move it with the arrow keys (Shift moves 10 px).
crop.noImages: Add an image to adjust the crop.

project.name: Project name
project.replaceConfirm: Replace the current project? Anything you haven’t saved will be lost.
project.newConfirm: Start a new project? Anything you haven’t saved will be lost.
project.invalid: {{name}} isn’t a PnP Cards or PDFCartas project.
project.newer: {{name}} was saved with a newer version of PnP Cards. Reload the page to update it.
project.saveFailed: The project couldn’t be saved. Try another folder.

folder.title: Open “{{name}}”
folder.intro_one: The project uses {{count}} image. Point to the folder it’s in: it is found by its path or, failing that, its name.
folder.intro_other: The project uses {{count}} images. Point to the folder they’re in: they are found by their path or, failing that, their name.
folder.restoreTitle: Pick up where you left off?
folder.restoreIntro_one: Your last session was “{{name}}”, with {{count}} image. To continue, open its folder again.
folder.restoreIntro_other: Your last session was “{{name}}”, with {{count}} images. To continue, open its folder again.
folder.hint: Last time the images were in the “{{name}}” folder.
folder.denied: No permission to read the folder. Press again and choose “Allow”, or choose the folder.
folder.gone: The “{{name}}” folder can’t be found. It may have moved: choose it again.

recent.title: Recent projects
recent.empty: Projects you open or save will appear here.
recent.note: Only the project and its folder are remembered; the images stay in your folder.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.intro: Combine several PDFs into one, in list order. Drag to change the order.
merge.clearConfirm: Remove all PDFs from the list?
merge.empty: Drop the PDFs you want to merge here or press “Add PDFs”.
merge.unreadable: Can’t be read: it’s damaged or password-protected.
merge.needTwo: Add at least two PDFs to merge them.
merge.errorUnreadable: {{name}} couldn’t be read: it’s damaged or password-protected. Remove it and try again.
merge.dropHere: Drop the PDFs to add them
merge.notPdf_one: {{names}} isn’t a PDF and wasn’t added.

split.title: Split image
split.intro: Cut sheets with several cards into one image per card. Adjust the area, rows and columns; parts are saved as PNG, with no loss of quality.
split.clearConfirm: Remove all images from the list?
split.empty: Drop the sheets you want to split here or press “Add images”.
split.dropHere: Drop the images to add them
split.partSizeUneven: Each part: about {{w}} × {{h}} px ({{wmm}} × {{hmm}} mm); the remainder is shared out
split.hint: Drag the area to move it and its corners to resize it, or move it with the arrow keys (Shift moves 10 px).

pdfToImages.title: PDF to images
pdfToImages.intro: Turn the pages of a PDF into images, at the resolution you choose.
pdfToImages.empty: Drop a PDF here or press “Choose PDF”.
pdfToImages.dropHere: Drop the PDF to open it
pdfToImages.unreadable: {{name}} can’t be read: it’s damaged or password-protected.
pdfToImages.rangeInvalid: Enter pages between 1 and {{count}}, for example “1-3, 5”.
pdfToImages.size: The first page will be {{w}} × {{h}} px.
pdfToImages.big: At this resolution each page takes a lot of memory. If it fails, lower the dpi.

extract.title: Extract images
extract.intro: Pull out the images inside a PDF, at their original resolution. Repeated ones are saved once, with “ xN” in the name.
extract.empty: Drop a PDF here or press “Choose PDF”.
extract.dropHere: Drop the PDF to open it
extract.ignoreSmallHint: Icons and ornaments that aren’t cards.
extract.none: This PDF has no images to extract.
extract.encrypted: {{name}} is password-protected and can’t be read.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Place the slots wherever you like: each card fills one slot, in the order of their numbers. To use it, choose “Template” in the Cards layout.
templates.empty: Create a blank template or one from the layout you use in Cards.
templates.name: Name
templates.noSlot: Choose a slot to edit it, or add one.
templates.hint: Drag the slots to move them and their corners to resize them (to the millimetre). With a slot selected, the arrow keys move it 1 mm (Shift: 10 mm).
templates.outside: Some slots go off the page.
